title: Note-Taking Website
description: A simple website for users to create, edit, and manage notes.

features.name: Create Notes
features.description: Allows users to create new notes with a title and content.

features.name: Edit Notes
features.description: Enables users to edit the content of existing notes.

features.name: Delete Notes
features.description: Provides functionality to delete notes that are no longer needed.

features.name: View Notes
features.description: Allows users to view a list of all their saved notes.

target_users: Individuals looking for a simple tool to manage their notes.
data_requirements: Requires storage for saving user notes, including titles and content.
